text: {"quantities":[{"id":"q1","value":2,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"help 2 people per hour"},{"id":"q2","value":3,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"3 hours a day"},{"id":"q3","value":20,"unit":"%","kind":"count","span":"20% of the days"},{"id":"q4","value":31,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"31 days in March"},{"id":"q5","value":19,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"April 19th"},{"id":"q6","value":1,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"March 1st"}],"plan":[{"op":"add","args":["q4","q5"],"out":"s1","note":"add the 31 days of March and the 19 days into April to find total days from March 1 through April 19"},{"op":"mul","args":["s1","q3"],"out":"s2","note":"multiply total days by the percentage number (20) to represent the 20% of days taken off"},{"op":"sub","args":["s1","s2"],"out":"s3","note":"subtract the days off from total days to find how many days Billy actually works"},{"op":"mul","args":["q1","q2"],"out":"s4","note":"multiply people helped per hour (2) by hours per day (3) to find people helped per working day"},{"op":"mul","args":["s3","s4"],"out":"s5","note":"multiply working days by people helped per day to find the total number of people Billy helps"}],"target":{"kind":"count","scope":"total number of people Billy helps with taxes"},"dismissed":[{"value":1,"reason":"names the starting date, March 1st; the length of March is already captured by the separately stated 31-days quantity, so this date number isn't a separate duration to add"}]}
